CALL TO ORDER

ROLL CALL

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  26-54864  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Economic Development and
  Opportunity Committee meeting of Tuesday, December 16, 2025.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

2.  26-54865  Recommendation to receive and file an update on Business Outreach and
  Education including Business Walks, Know Your Rights, and Economic Impacts.

items. Each speaker is limited to three minutes to make their comments unless extended by the
Chair.

I, Jonathan Nagayama, City Clerk Analyst, certify that the agenda was posted not less than 72 hours
prior to the meeting.
